description: Turns "risk 1% of equity, stop 2% below" into a size in the base coin, rounded down to the venue step and capped by every limit (this agent's, the person's and TradeHub's). Reads equity, mark and contract rules itself: no need for get_my_account_balances or get_perp_contract_rules first. Use before every preview_perp_order. Not an order: nothing is sent. Inputs: symbol, stop_loss (USD) or stop_pct with side, risk_pct or risk_usd (default: the most allowed), venue, entry_price (default: mark), leverage. Next: preview_perp_order with the returned size_base, stop_loss and leverage.

entry_price.description: Planned entry, USD per coin; omitted: the mark

leverage.description: Leverage for the margin estimate, e.g. 5

notional_usd.description: Or the position's value in USD ("buy $200 worth"), instead of risk_pct / risk_usd; still capped by the risk limits

risk_pct.description: Loss at stop as a fraction of equity (0.01 = 1%); omitted with risk_usd also omitted: the largest your limits allow

risk_usd.description: Loss at stop in USD (instead of risk_pct)

side.description: buy = long, sell = short; needed with stop_pct

stop_loss.description: Stop-loss price, USD per coin; below entry for a long, above for a short. Or give stop_pct and side instead

stop_pct.description: Stop distance from entry as a fraction (0.02 = 2%), instead of stop_loss; needs side

venue.description: Venue: sandbox, hyperliquid, okx, bybit or binance. Omitted: the agent's only venue, else hyperliquid, else your only connected venue, else sandbox

name: size_position_by_risk

capped_by.description: Which limit made the size smaller than asked, if any

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

entry_price.description: Entry used, USD per coin (the mark when not given)

equity_usd.description: Equity used for the calculation (the venue's book), USD

margin_usd.description: Margin needed at the given leverage, USD

risk_usd.description: Loss if the stop fills, USD

side.description: buy (long) or sell (short), from the stop's side of entry

size_base.description: Suggested size, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD, rounded down to the venue's size step; pass it to preview_perp_order as size_base

within_limits.description: False if even the capped size cannot pass (e.g. below the venue minimum)

title: Size a position by risk
